sevenmau.name: 7-mau.com
sevenmau.desc: Built and managed the largest CS2 game server community in Vietnam. Configured servers, optimized performance, administered game modes, and fostered an active community of players.
sevenmau.f1: Diverse Game Server Infrastructure: Host high-performance Retakes, PUG, Duel, 1v1 game modes on optimized tickrates
sevenmau.f2: 10K+ Community Engagement: Developed and managed an active Discord and social group connecting gamers daily
sevenmau.f3: Automated Integrations: Synchronized in-game Skin Changer, Rank, VIP status, and shop features
sevenmau.f4: Low Latency Networking: Servers hosted in top Vietnamese datacenters protected by custom anti-cheat shields

zsystems.name: zSystems
zsystems.desc: AIO web dashboard integrated stats tracker, player leaderboard, ban/mute logs, online store, and automated donation checkout system for 7-Màu servers.
zsystems.f1: Modern user interface optimized for mobile layout
zsystems.f2: Integrated Source Query API for real-time stats & leaderboards
zsystems.f3: Bi-directional sync of Ban/Mute/Kick records directly with CS2 server

ntmg.name: NTMG (Nhà trẻ Mèo Giặt)
ntmg.desc: Focused exclusively on web optimization and source code refactoring under robust international standards.
ntmg.f1: Optimize web performance and architecture structure
ntmg.f2: Refactor and maintain source code matching global industry standards
ntmg.f3: Ensure robust security protocols and maximum scalability

swiftly.name: SwiftlyS2 Plugins
swiftly.desc: Authored high-performance, customized server plugins using the SwiftlyS2 Framework to deliver unique gameplay features for game servers.
swiftly.f1: Optimized custom gameplay extensions using SwiftlyS2 C# APIs
swiftly.f2: Designed VIP management, custom skin selectors, and rewards modules
swiftly.f3: Automated stats loggers and map voting systems
